theme: 3 terms for compact SwiftUI screens: a pop-up list of actions, a section that opens and an empty state

terms.definition: A button that opens a small list of actions when the user taps it.
terms.example: Put the three sort buttons into a Menu.

terms.definition: A container that the user can open and close to show or hide its content.
terms.example: Use a DisclosureGroup for the advanced filters.

terms.definition: A view that explains why a screen is empty, for example when a search finds nothing.
terms.example: Show a ContentUnavailableView when the list is empty.

video.title: Menu, DisclosureGroup & ContentUnavailableView | Day 163
video.description:
Learn to explain how to keep SwiftUI screens compact and clear: Menu, DisclosureGroup & ContentUnavailableView, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Menu - A button that opens a small list of actions when the user taps it.
DisclosureGroup - A container that the user can open and close to show or hide its content.
ContentUnavailableView - A view that explains why a screen is empty, for example when a search finds nothing.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

한국어: 메뉴: 사용자가 탭하면 작은 동작 목록을 펼쳐 주는 버튼

한국어: 컨텐트언어베일러블뷰: 검색 결과가 없을 때처럼 화면이 비어 있는 이유를 설명해 주는 뷰

landscape.hook: Can you explain Menu, DisclosureGroup and ContentUnavailableView in English?

dialogue.title: A crowded toolbar

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my toolbar has five buttons, and it looks crowded.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put them into a Menu. It opens a small list of actions when the user taps it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I made a Menu called `Sort`, and the toolbar is clean now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Next, your filter screen is long, right?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I want the filters to open and close.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a DisclosureGroup. The user taps the arrow to show or hide the content.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the DisclosureGroup closed at the start?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, unless you pass a binding for the open state.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When the filters find nothing, the screen is empty and confusing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Show a ContentUnavailableView. It explains why the screen is empty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I add a title and an icon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The ContentUnavailableView in the code has the title `No results` and a magnifying glass icon.
